principals.description: The default identity: unrestricted rows, unmasked PII.
Northvale Air's own operations analyst: their flights, their airframes, their crew, and their crew's contact details masked.

Row-restricted like the analyst but cleared for personal data. The two axes are independent: seeing fewer rows and seeing more of each row are different grants, and collapsing them into one role is how a masking policy ends up keyed off the wrong thing.
Sees the Meridian alliance's carriers -- BlueQuay and Regia Connect. A multi-value grant, which is the case a single-value implementation quietly gets wrong.
